_what: Which M-IDs in a re-mint's scope pass the draft readiness gate (d-remint-ready-gate-draft-s707, Sam's to set), and why each of the rest is held. Read by the Subjects page and the re-mint dry run. Written by kb/_mid_readiness.py; nothing here is a decision.
_gate: every member's code is Confident (r-confidence-not-person-settled-sam-2026-11-23): a person's move of that course, a person's save for that college's code (noncredit under its own category), a person's statewide filing, a noncredit course's COCI category code, or the code's statewide call at 90% or more
the settled codes give one code or a split along the codes; both pass
the outcomes comparison ran on the current reads, and no strong or partial split waits on an answer

_sources.state_list: coci_lookup_data.js (band and category where a catalog is not filed)

aed.why: AED (Adult Education) gave 45 shared M-IDs an ELEC prefix through the subject map (f-aed-electricity-gave-elec-m90-s707); AED is unmapped since #3693.
